title: VK-only Write Multiple Coils with alternate unit and packed boundary-adjacent data
purpose: Exercise coil-count, byte-count, packed-bit data, and unit-identifier interactions in a valid multi-coil request related structurally to the reported read-IO-status unit mutation evidence.

messages.label: write nine packed coils from alternate unit identifier

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse nine coil values from two data bytes and return the normal Write Multiple Coils acknowledgment or an address/value exception response.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0008 equals unit identifier plus the seven-byte request PDU.
Quantity 0009 requires byte count 02, and two packed data bytes are present.
Unit identifier 7c varies the response-routing field without changing PDU layout.
issue_safety_notes: The unit-identifier variation is an issue-supported structural relation, not a reproduction claim. Historical crash bytes are not copied; the request remains internally length-consistent and valid.
